EVAL-P-M2-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-M2-S1.description: Define the data model and contract for representing specialty match accuracy, including NUCC code alignment, match score, and classification (exact, partial, mismatch).

EVAL-P-M2-S2.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
EVAL-P-M2-S2.description: Implement logic to compare user condition-derived specialties against provider NUCC taxonomy codes and compute a normalized match score with classification tiers.

EVAL-P-M2-S3.title: Integrate Specialty Match Accuracy into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-M2-S3.description: Expose specialty match accuracy results through the evaluate_care_facade, ensuring compatibility with provider detail and evaluation workflows.

EVAL-P-M2-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
EVAL-P-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests for scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty extraction to evaluation output.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-2.mitigation: Leverage existing NUCC taxonomy mapping and specialty_service logic to avoid new taxonomy complexity.
